scope: New paired baseline observations only; never backfill old lab opportunities or frozen rec-half experiment
capture_policy: Observe immutable website board and matching metadata before each NEW lab row feature cutoff; persist hash-bound row references before kickoff; no later-retry backfill
durability: Lab stores only source/row digests, identities, clocks and remote publication receipts. Grading recovers same immutable upstream blob or abstains; no upstream retention guarantee.

numeric_semantics.raw_sleeper: Literal website prop.proj; rounded site-extracted point, not full precision original feed
numeric_semantics.pinned_website: Literal prop.adj; historical-average fallback remains website-only
numeric_semantics.anytime_td: Literal site td_chance only when finite nonnegative proj exists; website probability, not native raw Sleeper probability
numeric_semantics.fantasy_ppr: Website display baseline only; exact lab outcomes still require all pinned components

evaluation.supported_population: Same canonical lab player/game/target/period/scoring identity with verified timely receipts; unknown/DNP/missing stats separate
evaluation.selected_lines: Not captured by this protocol; no hit-rate/EV claim
evaluation.promotion: none; existing prospective confirmation gates unchanged
